title: Crispy Greek Fish
description: A gluten-free and crispy Greek-style fish dish perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt, pepper, and dill.
Dip each fillet in the Greek pastitsio, coating both sides evenly.
Dip the coated fillet in the crispy breadcrumbs, pressing gently to ensure they stick.
Heat 1/2 inch (1 cm) of fish oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the coated snapper fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with lemon slices and wedges.
